cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put a sticker on the leaking tap, so I've put one on the sink and worktop too. Let's replace the lot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sticker's the plumber's number. I put it there so you'd call about the drip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, direct contact. I'll call him about all three; he can disconnect everything while we take the worktop out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That worktop runs under every cupboard. We'd have to empty the whole kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll ask him to move the pipes too. If we're emptying it, we can put the sink on the other wall.

reason: Replace contradictory physical/list marks with a plumber-number sticker miscopied as a replacement mark; keep repair expansion.
